Akari (Light Up) Puzzle — Free Online

Place glowing cats on the grid so every empty cell is illuminated. Numbered walls tell you exactly how many cats are adjacent. No guessing required — pure logic.

Home > Akari

How to Play

  • Tap empty cells to place glowing cats
  • Lights shine in all four directions until blocked by a wall
  • Numbered cells show how many adjacent cats are needed
  • No two cats can see each other in the same row or column
  • Win when every empty cell is lit and all clues are satisfied

Difficulty Levels

  • Easy (5×5) — Perfect for beginners
  • Medium (7×7) — Standard challenge
  • Hard (9×9) — For experienced puzzlers
